messages:
pagerduty: [CRITICAL] service: inference-gateway - HTTP 5xx rate > 500r/s (threshold 200r/s). Pager: pd-incident-1717352468. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

incidentbot: automated check: downstream errors clustered at /v1/generate, sample 502/504. Affected regions: eu-west1, us-west2. Retention: 1h.

maria-oncall: ack — taking primary. tagging sam and jess.

sam-sre: on it. Loading dashboards now. Any customer-facing pages?

carla-product: support reports two customers saw timeouts in last 10m, ticket IDs #2451 #2452. Not widespread yet.

jess-runtime: quick triage: gateway logs show many upstream 502s with identical trace header. Looks like a retry storm hitting embed-proxy pools.

sam-sre: confirming. Top talker IPs show a single client sending burst retries. Rate-limited patterns: exponential backoff disabled on their side.

maria-oncall: mitigation idea: add a temporary route weight shift away from eu-west1 and enable 429 on emergent client bursts. Can we do that quickly?

jess-runtime: I can shift weights for non-enterprise traffic to reduce pressure in <3m. Also propose raising upstream timeout to 30s for gateway->embed-proxy to avoid mid-request 502s while we stabilize.

sam-sre: +1 to weight shift. Applying a soft throttle rule for top 5 client IPs (rate-limit to 20r/s) and enabling short-lived circuit-breaker for embed-proxy. Executing now.

incidentbot: action > routing: route-slice-shift initiated by jess-runtime. action > rate-limiter: ip-block/soft applied to 3 IPs.

carla-product: FYI: putting a banner in support Slack to notify affected customers and ask them to hold traffic.

dave-support: notified the two impacted customers; they confirm a retry loop from their SDK. They're rolling a patch to enable jitter/backoff. ETA 15m.

sam-sre: after weight shift + soft throttle, 5xx rate dropped to ~110r/s in eu-west and ~95r/s in us-west. Global 5xx now ~180r/s. Looks like mitigation is working.

maria-oncall: good. I'll keep pagerduty open until we see stable <200r/s for 30m. Need a followup: post-incident runbook item to improve automated detection of single-client retry storms.

jess-runtime: will capture KV cache churn and embed-proxy pod evictions in the post-incident notes. Also saving logs:```\nTop 502 sample:\n{"time":"2026-03-17T03:21:45Z","upstream":"embed-proxy-12","status":502,"trace":"trace-abc123","client_ip":"54.213.77.11","req_path":"/v1/generate"}\n```

sam-sre: tagging for follow-up: ops/alerts -> add a rule to correlate 5xx increases with client-IP concentration (e.g., >30% of 5xx from <5 IPs). That would reduce noisy autopaging.

carla-product: also suggest a customer-facing best-practices doc pointer for SDK retry backoff. I can draft.

dave-support: customers will push the SDK patch in ~10-15m; they asked for a timestamped log extract which I attached to tickets.

maria-oncall: marking current status: mitigated (rate decreased, customers patched soon). Keeping on-call until we hit stable threshold. Will schedule postmortem and assign owners: sam for alert tuning, jess for runtime changes, carla for docs.

incidentbot: escalation cleared by maria-oncall. Please add 'postmortem' label when creating the incident doc.

pagerduty: alert resolved (pd-incident-1717352468) — acknowledged by maria-oncall, duration 00:09:40.

maria-oncall: creating incident doc now and will ping owners. Closing thread once doc exists. Thanks all :thumbsup:
